### How to Amaze Jesus
Author: Amy Carroll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/-encouragement-for-today-january-7-2020.html
Passage: Matthew 8:10
Points:
- Modern culture demands bigger spectacles to be impressed, but God values inward character.
- The Roman centurion amazed Jesus through deep humility by laying aside his military authority.
- The soldier's request was entirely selfless, interceding on behalf of a suffering servant.
- He demonstrated boundless faith by trusting that Jesus could heal from afar simply by speaking.
- Jesus is not captivated by outward performance, but by humble and obedient trust.

### Faith That Made Jesus Marvel
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/faith-that-made-jesus-marvel
Passage: Luke 7:9
Points:
- The Gospels uniquely record Jesus marveling at the astonishing faith of a Roman centurion.
- Though an outsider to the covenant, the soldier recognized both divine holiness and his own unworthiness.
- Accustomed to military command, he realized Jesus possessed absolute authority over sickness across any distance.
- The centurion served as a foretaste of Gentiles entering the kingdom of God from east and west.
- True faith requires no religious credentials or titles, only humble reliance on who Jesus is.
